rvor.h: Off: nothing is computed. Your decisions stay.

ics.s: Your trips in any calendar app
ics.h: You see the link only once. Regenerating ends old subscriptions. Google Calendar needs a public server address.
ics.res: Link created · visible only now · Copy

personen.h: Merging changes every entry with this person and can't be undone.

anfragen.h: Withdrawing stops syncing. What's shared stays as an own copy.

fcodes.h: You redeem someone else's code here too.

linkserlaubt.h: Turning off revokes every link of every account at once.

linkliste.s: Created on a flight, trip or year

pushstate.h: Ready as soon as one paired phone allows notifications. The server must also be allowed to send them.

r_flight.h: Plus one own time, whole hours from 1 to 168.

tr_flight.h: Suggestions from your flights show up here to accept.

srvbackup.s: Your admin takes care of it

webdaveigen.h: Set up the connection under Services → Backup target.

excelexp.h: Edit it and read it back in, also into another account.

gpxzip.s: All tours as GPX in a ZIP

excelimp.h: Add · Merge · Replace. Replace affects every sheet in the file with at least one row and deletes what the file doesn't mention there. I take a backup of the whole server first.

gpxin.h: ZIP up to 500 files and 200 MB, one recording up to 15 MB.

implog.h: Entries something else already points to stay; I'll say which.

icsnew.title: Create new calendar link?
icsnew.amount: Every calendar using the old link

icsrevoke.title: Withdraw calendar link?
icsrevoke.after: Those calendars stop getting trips. You can create a new link at any time.

shareend.title: Stop sharing?
shareend.after: They stay as your copy; changes no longer arrive.
shareend.amount: All trips you share with this person

merge.title: Merge {{from}} into {{to}}?
merge.after: They will name {{to}}. This can't be undone.

companiondel.title: Delete {{name}}?
companiondel.after: The person disappears from all suggestions.

linksoff.title: Turn off public links?
linksoff.after: I delete them at once. Turning on again won't bring them back.

replace.title: Replace contents?
replace.amount: {{missing}} entries are missing from the file and will be deleted. {{kept}} come from {{file}}.
replace.after: These sheets will only hold what the file contains. I take a backup of the whole server first.

carddelete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
carddelete.after: The card and its links to airlines, chains or hotels are gone. Your flights, stays and journeys stay.

rpid.title: Change passkey domain?
rpid.after: None will work; each must be created again.

userdel.title: Delete {{name}}?
userdel.affects: The account {{name}} with all entries and files
userdel.after: It can only be restored from a backup.

userlock.title: Lock {{name}}?
userlock.after: They can't sign in. Their data stays.

user2fa.title: Reset second step?
user2fa.after: They sign in with password only until they set it up again.

invrevoke.title: Revoke invitation?
invrevoke.after: The link stops working at once.

restore.title: Restore backup?
restore.after: Everything changed since is gone. I'll back up the current state first.

restorekey.title: Re-enter the services’ credentials?
restorekey.amount: Every stored key and password of the services
restorekey.after: The backup uses a different key; I can't decrypt these credentials and you enter them again afterwards. Or put the original key (ENCRYPTION_KEY) back and try once more.

bakdel.title: Delete backup?
bakdel.after: I delete the WebDAV copy too if “Also clean up on WebDAV” is on.

logclean.title: Delete old logs?
logclean.after: They can no longer be viewed.

logdel.title: Delete log file?
logdel.after: It can no longer be viewed.

reseed.title: Re-read catalogues?
reseed.amount: All shipped entries; your own stay
reseed.after: Shipped entries are up to date. Works three times an hour.

demodel.title: Delete demo account?
demodel.after: No one can sign in as demo any more.

mine.h: If your admin switched the service off, it stays off.

ownKey.h: Your key wins over the server's. It's stored encrypted and never shown again.

on.s: Off: no requests, not even a test
on.h: Applies to every account, even with its own key.

instKey.s: For every account without its own
instKey.h: Leave empty to keep the stored key.

allowConn.h: Each account enters its own credentials.
allowConn.us: Your admin doesn't allow own connections

test.h: Checks the saved setup. The result stays with its time.

quota.h: As reported by the provider. TravStats stops before the limit.

aiAllow.s: Each account then agrees on its own
aiAllow.h: What goes there: the text of an e-mail or PDF, at most 12,000 characters, only when templates find nothing.

aiConsent.h: At most 12,000 characters per e-mail or PDF. If the provider's address changes, I'll ask again.

openData.p: Markets and places from open data

osksec.h: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

oskidI.s: For every account without its own

immurl.h: May be on your local network.

immmode.h: Link shows photos from Immich and copies nothing. Copy downloads the originals to this server.

immvisit.res: Running · 37 places · done in about 1 minute

dawkey.h: Your connection is the only one used for location source, stay search and country days.

dawinsturl.s: Only for tour and cruise tracks
dawinsturl.h: Location source, stays and country days need each account's own connection. Otherwise every account would see one person's movements.

dawsweep.s: For every account with its own connection
dawsweep.h: Otherwise runs nightly. May take a few minutes.

stravaconn.h: Strava data never goes to an AI.

ollremote.s: Then each account agrees on its own

wdsrvpw.h: Stored encrypted. Save first, then test.

smtppw.s: Gmail and Outlook need an app password

smtpdel.h: After that the server sends no mail at all.

pushon.h: Off: the server never contacts the push service.

pushconsent.h: The push service learns the phone's ID and the notification text, nothing else.

pushrelay.h: A different address registers the server again.

fedkey.h: A new key cuts all connections until the others confirm it again.

fedpeers.h: An imported file trusts no one yet; only “Trust” does.

nutzstat.h: The install ID is shown in the help. If the receiver is disabled at start, nothing is sent.

ui.serverHint: Applies to every account on this server.
ui.serverLoadFailed: I couldn't load the server's settings.
ui.intro: This is where TravStats gets data from and where something goes. The top of each card says what applies to your account; as an admin you see below it what applies to everyone.
ui.quotaUnknown: The provider hasn't reported anything yet
ui.sweepPartial: Done, but something went wrong for {{failed}} accounts · {{users}} accounts, {{days}} days written.
ui.sweepLost: I don't know if it finished. The server restarted in between.
ui.sweepFailed: I couldn't count the country days.
ui.modelsUnknown: I can't get the model list
ui.immichModeLoadFailed: I couldn't read how new photos are taken over by default.

reason.auth: I can't get in: the key was rejected.
reason.unauthorized: I can't get in: the key was rejected.
reason.http_error: Something other than {{name}} answers at this address.
reason.not_found: I find nothing at this address.
reason.rate_limited: The provider is throttling. I'll try later.
reason.budget_exhausted: The monthly budget is reached. I'll ask again next month.
reason.disabled: Switched off by your admin. I won't ask, not even for a test.

smtp.SMTP_CONNECTION: I can't reach the mail server. Are address and port right?
smtp.SMTP_TLS: The encrypted connection doesn't come up. Do the port and "Directly encrypted" fit together?
smtp.SMTP_AUTH: I can't get in: user or password were rejected.
smtp.SMTP_TIMEOUT: No answer from the mail server after 8 seconds.
smtp.SMTP_PASSWORD_MISSING: I'm missing the password. Enter it and I'll check again.
smtp.SMTP_UNKNOWN: The mail server didn't accept that.

smtpdel.title: Delete the mail credentials?
smtpdel.affects: Server, user and password for sending mail
smtpdel.after: Afterwards the server sends no mail at all: no invitations, no reminders, no new password.

pushreset.title: Reset the registration with the push service?
pushreset.affects: This server's registration with the push service
pushreset.after: The server registers again with the next notification. You don't have to pair the phones again.

loginbilder.s: Everyone sees them, signed in or not
loginbilder.h: Removing all brings back the shipped ones.

puburl.s: For invitations, e-mails and password resets
puburl.h: Required. Without it, links point to localhost. Calendar feeds and the Strava return use it too.

pairurl.h: Empty: the address you have TravStats open at right now. Passkeys use it when no allowed addresses are set.

lanurl.h: Phones don't get it; pairing uses the address for phones.

rpid.h: Changing it voids every passkey ever created.

origins.s: One per line, with https and port
origins.h: The first one counts. Several only on the same domain. Empty: the address for phones.

beta.h: Opens: pairing phones, tours, planning, ship tracks, flight path upload, leaderboard, encrypted handover, calendar feed, sharing with other servers, TravTrack.

tpoffer.h: Off keeps all plans, only hides them.

leserfolge.h: Templates read flight mails in under a second.

kiaktiv.h: Off: no AI, even if Ollama is set up.

cloudorder.h: Only providers with key and approval are tried.

server.loadFailed: I couldn't load the server's settings.

errors.scheme: I need http:// or https:// at the start of the address.
errors.domain: I need a domain, not an IP address.

server.publicUrlMissing: Still missing. Until then invitations, e-mails and calendars point to localhost.
server.publicUrlBanner: The public address is still missing. Until then invitations, e-mails and calendars point to localhost.

deps.needsBeta: The server only offers this with beta features.

server.offersLoadFailed: I couldn't read whether TravTrack and planning are offered.

parsers.testNoModel: Reachable, but the model {{model}} is missing.

cloud.loadFailed: I couldn't read which providers are on.
cloud.noneEnabled: No provider is on. Switch one on under Services.

registr.h: Anyone can then create an account until the maximum is reached.

nutzerliste.h: Per account under ⋯: lock, set new password, reset second step, delete.

einlliste.s: A link works once, for 7 days
einlliste.h: By e-mail only works if the server sends mail.

errors.lock: I couldn't lock or unlock the account.
errors.reset2fa: I couldn't reset the second step.

users.noMail: By e-mail only works once the server sends mail. Set it up under Services.

bakhalten.h: The last full backup always stays.

bakliste.h: Per backup under ⋯: download, upload, restore, delete.

backups.loadFailed: I couldn't load the backup settings.

deps.webdavOff: Only works with the WebDAV copy.
deps.webdavUnknown: Only works with the WebDAV copy. I can't read its state right now.

errors.webdavStatus: I can't read whether the WebDAV copy is on, so uploading and the list of cloud backups are missing.

backups.zoneEffective: The server is backing up in {{zone}} right now.

restoreFailure.keyMismatch: The backup uses a different key.
restoreFailure.unknown: I don't know whether the restore finished: the server restarted meanwhile. Check the backups and your data.
restoreFailure.incomplete: The archive is missing the part you chose. I restored nothing.
restoreFailure.unreadable: I can't read the file part of the archive. I restored nothing.
restoreFailure.migrationFailed: The archive is older and couldn't be brought to this version's state. I changed nothing.
restoreFailure.schemaIncomplete: I restored the archive, but the database is missing something this version needs. Details are in the server log.
restoreFailure.newer: This archive is from a newer version. I won't restore it; update this server first.
restoreFailure.unversioned: I can't match this archive's database state to a version. I changed nothing.
restoreFailure.busy: A backup or restore is running right now. Try again afterwards.
restoreFailure.rateLimited: I restore only a few backups an hour. Try again later.

enrich.s: Pulls an airport missing from the catalogue from the external source
enrich.h: Enter the IATA code (3 letters) or the ICAO code (4 letters). An airport already in the catalogue stays as it is.
enrich.placeholder: IATA or ICAO, e.g. FRA or EDDF

failure.invalidCode: That is not an airport code. I need 3 letters (IATA) or 4 (ICAO).
failure.notFound: The external source has no airport for this code.
failure.forbidden: This account may not do that (demo account or read-only access).
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.unreachable: The external source did not answer, so I cannot tell whether the airport exists.

reseed.h: At most three times an hour. Entries you added stay untouched.

failure.rateLimited: Works three times an hour. Try again later.
failure.forbidden: I need an admin for this.
failure.statusFailed: I couldn't read the state and don't know whether it finished.

maintenance.systemLoadFailed: I couldn't load the system data.
maintenance.usersLoadFailed: I couldn't load the accounts for the report.

deps.envPinned: Pinned at server start (LOG_LEVEL). In effect: {{level}}.

errors.export: I couldn't put the data together.
errors.demo: I couldn't delete the demo account.

maintenance.nothingOld: No file is older than the retention.
